fields.label: Heading
fields.name: destination_problem_heading
fields.placeholder: The problem TXA solves for destinations

fields.label: Description
fields.name: destination_problem_copy
fields.placeholder: Marketing a destination to inspire is easy. Converting that interest into actual regional bookings is where most DMOs struggle.

fields.label: Problem 1 Copy
fields.name: destination_problem_1_copy
fields.placeholder: Suppliers use 100+ different booking systems, making a central portal impossible.

fields.label: Problem 2 Copy
fields.name: destination_problem_2_copy
fields.placeholder: Users leave the destination site to book, resulting in massive drop-offs, booking funds going offshore and lost data.

fields.label: Problem 3 Copy
fields.name: destination_problem_3_copy
fields.placeholder: DMOs know who looks at pages, but not who actually visits the region.

fields.label: Problem 4 Copy
fields.name: destination_problem_4_copy
fields.placeholder: Updating content and product status across platforms is labor-intensive.

fields.label: Solution 1 Copy
fields.name: destination_solution_1_copy
fields.placeholder: One connection to TXA unlocks bookable local inventory regardless of software.

fields.label: Solution 2 Copy
fields.name: destination_solution_2_copy
fields.placeholder: Keep visitors on your domain from inspiration to confirmation.

fields.label: Solution 3 Copy
fields.name: destination_solution_3_copy
fields.placeholder: Own the transaction data and attribution for every campaign dollar spent.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: destination_capabilities_heading
fields.placeholder: Your destination, your digital assets, your commercial model

fields.label: Capability 1 Copy
fields.name: destination_capability_1_copy
fields.placeholder: Use B2B and B2C destination websites, apps, APIs, widgets and custom booking pages to connect brand, content and conversion.

fields.label: Capability 2 Copy
fields.name: destination_capability_2_copy
fields.placeholder: Support multiple supplier pathways, including connected systems, free or low-cost booking options, on-request, content-only and smart referral models.

fields.label: Capability 3 Copy
fields.name: destination_capability_3_copy
fields.placeholder: Data and insights to drive growth that belongs to your destination, not a third-party platform.

fields.label: Capability 4 Copy
fields.name: destination_capability_4_copy
fields.placeholder: Aggregate supplier and destination content and make it available to distributors, trade channels, DMO-owned assets and connected APIs.

fields.label: Capability 5 Copy
fields.name: destination_capability_5_copy
fields.placeholder: Use a platform model that supports multiple booking systems and commercial models.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: destination_data_heading
fields.placeholder: See who is visiting, what is working and where to invest next

fields.label: Paragraph 1
fields.name: destination_data_paragraph_1
fields.placeholder: Most destination marketing generates interest that's impossible to trace. Visitors click through to OTA listings or third-party pages, and the data disappears. TXA gives destinations something different: first-party booking and engagement data that belongs to you.

fields.label: Paragraph 2
fields.name: destination_data_paragraph_2
fields.placeholder: For the first time, your destination can see, in one place, which campaigns converted, which suppliers are performing, and where visitor spend is flowing through your local economy.

fields.label: Bullet 1 Text
fields.name: destination_data_point_1_text
fields.placeholder: Real-time Dashboards: Track supplier activity, campaign performance and visitor engagement in one place.

fields.label: Bullet 2 Text
fields.name: destination_data_point_2_text
fields.placeholder: Attribution and ROI: Connect marketing spend to actual booking outcomes with attribution codes.

fields.label: Bullet 3 Text
fields.name: destination_data_point_3_text
fields.placeholder: Data Ownership and Integration: Export insights or use APIs to flow data into your CRM or BI tools.
